overview_description.description: Feathery develops an AI-powered platform that helps financial services organizations automate data collection, document processing, and operational workflows. The platform supports processes such as client onboarding, risk assessment, account opening, underwriting, and policy analysis while integrating with customer relationship management systems, policy management platforms, custodians, and other business applications. It includes tools for extracting and structuring information from documents, generating forms and business documents, and managing workflow automation across multiple systems. Feathery also provides decisioning capabilities that analyze operational data to support workflow execution and improve data consistency across connected systems. Its platform is used by insurance and wealth management organizations to streamline information intake, reduce manual processing, and manage business operations more efficiently.

about_short_description.short_description: Feathery is an agentic data intake platform that automates operational workflows for financial services companies.

product.name: Feathery AI Operations Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for building and running data-intake and operational workflows for insurance, wealth management, and other regulated financial-services organizations.

product.name: Robin AI Workflow Assistant
product.description: An AI assistant that creates, modifies, and operates Feathery workflows from natural-language instructions, including forms, logic, integrations, and document flows.

product.name: Form Builder
product.description: A no-code form development tool for creating responsive, branded forms with conditional logic, validation, calculations, analytics, file uploads, and API connections.

product.name: Document Intelligence
product.description: An AI document-processing service that extracts, validates, compares, and structures data from PDFs, spreadsheets, images, emails, Word files, audio, and other unstructured inputs.

product.name: Document Templates & eSignatures
product.description: Tools for filling, generating, merging, and electronically signing PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents using workflow data.

product.name: Meeting & Audio Intelligence
product.description: An AI meeting-notetaking and audio-processing service that transcribes conversations and extracts structured information for operational workflows.
